_label: G029 / S010 §4. WHY the MLP resists compression -- the mechanism, not a bit count. Two hypotheses tested and REFUTED, and the surviving explanation turned into a cheap pre-flight diagnostic.
_evidence: MEASURED on CPU: weight statistics, singular-value spectra against a matched RANDOM GAUSSIAN control, and falsifiable representation experiments at matched complete EBPW.

REJECTED_HYPOTHESIS_1_outlier_channels.claim: MLP damage is dominated by a small set of outlier output channels; preserving them at fp16 while crushing the bulk should beat uniform allocation.
REJECTED_HYPOTHESIS_1_outlier_channels.test: hot/cold decomposition, hottest 1/2/5% of output channels kept fp16 (indices and values fully counted), bulk at 2-3 bits, at matched or lower complete EBPW than the uniform control.
REJECTED_HYPOTHESIS_1_outlier_channels.result: REFUTED. Uniform g64 4b gives EBPW 4.500 / top-1 0.7476. Hot 5% + cold 3b gives a LOWER EBPW of 4.334 and a much WORSE top-1 of 0.5734. At 2-bit bulk every variant collapses (2058-11278x perplexity) regardless of how many channels are protected.
REJECTED_HYPOTHESIS_1_outlier_channels.why: there are no outliers to preserve. MLP kurtosis is 3.3-4.0 against a Gaussian's exactly 3.0.

REJECTED_HYPOTHESIS_2_low_rank.claim: a low-rank component carries the MLP's important information; factor it out and quantise the residual harder.
REJECTED_HYPOTHESIS_2_low_rank.test: rank-64/128 SVD factors kept fp16 and fully counted, residual at 3 bits.
REJECTED_HYPOTHESIS_2_low_rank.result: REFUTED. MLP low-rank r64 gives EBPW 4.648 / top-1 0.5695 against the control's 4.500 / 0.7476 -- worse on BOTH axes. Also tested on the embedding organ, where it is merely NEUTRAL (4.502 / 0.7339 against 4.500 / 0.7476), not a win.
REJECTED_HYPOTHESIS_2_low_rank.why: the organ is not low-rank. See the random-matrix control below.

THE_MECHANISM.measurement: top-64 singular-value energy of each real weight matrix, divided by the same statistic for an i.i.d. Gaussian matrix of IDENTICAL SHAPE and standard deviation. A ratio near 1.0 means the organ is spectrally indistinguishable from random.
THE_MECHANISM.reading: MLP tensors sit at 1.32-1.69x random with kurtosis 3.70-4.00. They are very nearly STRUCTURELESS: almost no low-rank component, almost no heavy tail. Every weight carries close to independent information, so there is nothing for a structural representation class to exploit and bit-width is the only lever that moves. The embedding organ sits at 3.15x random -- genuinely more structured -- which is WHY it tolerated 2-bit quantisation ~1000x better than the MLP did. Attention q_proj has the heaviest tail (kurtosis 6.76), consistent with the known attention-outlier picture, and is a better hot/cold target than the MLP ever was.
THE_MECHANISM.explains_every_prior_failure: the low-rank residual failed because the organ is not low-rank; the hot/cold scheme failed because it is not outlier-concentrated; only bit-width helped because the information is spread uniformly. Three independent failures, one cause.

TRANSFERABLE_LAW_strong_form: Under grouped-affine, low-rank-residual and hot/cold representation classes, Qwen3-0.6B MLP damage is NOT dominated by outlier channels and NOT concentrated in a low-rank subspace: the organ's top-64 singular-value energy is within 1.32-1.69x of an i.i.d. Gaussian of the same shape and its kurtosis is 3.70-4.00 against 3.00. An organ that is spectrally indistinguishable from random has nothing for a structural class to exploit, and responds only to bit-width. DIAGNOSE THIS BEFORE CHOOSING A CLASS: compute top-k SV energy against a matched random control. Ratio <~2 predicts structural classes will fail; the higher the ratio, the more a structural class can be expected to pay. On this body the ratio correctly RANKED organ tolerance (embedding 3.15 neutral, MLP 1.3-1.7 catastrophic) even though 3.15x was still not enough to make rank-64 factors profitable.
cost_of_this_diagnostic: one SVD per sampled tensor plus one on a random matrix of the same shape -- seconds on CPU, and it would have predicted the failure of BOTH rejected classes before either was implemented.
